name: Lisa Batey
occupation: Mayor of Milwaukie; Founding Board Member, Milwaukie Parks Foundation

bio.statement: The City of Milwaukie mayor page says Batey was first elected November 8, 2022, with a term expiring December 31, 2026.
Batey's pamphlet statement lists a J.D. from the University of Michigan Law School and a B.A. from Syracuse University.
bio.excerpt: University of Michigan Law School, J.D.; Syracuse University, B.A.

bio.statement: Batey's pamphlet statement lists prior service as a Milwaukie city councilor and planning commissioner; she is a retired attorney.
bio.excerpt: Milwaukie City Councilor; Milwaukie Planning Commissioner

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Batey lists completing Milwaukie Bay Park, removing Kellogg Dam and strengthening ties with the business community.
positions.excerpt: Also completing Milwaukie Bay Park, removing Kellogg Dam, and strengthening ties with our business community.

positions.statement: Batey's pamphlet statement supports adding housing in a measured way that preserves Milwaukie's small-town feel.
positions.excerpt: adding housing in a measured way that doesn’t destroy Milwaukie’s small-town feel
